question: Does adding the 52-week-high signal midway through an existing momentum holding improve performance?
control: ROLL_MOM_WEIGHT exact same rolling selected entry strategy, dates and cohort maturity
treatment: Once, at each cohort midpoint floor(H/2), redistribute that cohort among its existing names using factor0.5+cross-sectional52-week-nearness percentile. Normalize to that cohort's current market value before stock cap. Rebalance next close only; do not reset maturity, add external money, choose new names or change the momentum policy schedule. No reweight if absolute lot trade below0.05% NAV; stock new-allocation cap8%. Cash may differ due to caps, threshold and transaction costs; report exposure.
inference: Predefined matched treatment-minus-control comparison, not a new optimized winner or a claim that arbitrary later feature additions help. Same costs and sensitivities as base.
